trials.rule_text: Before claiming a test-suite fix is green, inspect the authoritative results artifact, verify every test result individually, and report any regression or trade-off, even when the command output says all tests passed.

Run the requested test command, then inspect its authoritative results artifact and verify every test entry—including unrelated tests—before claiming success; report any regression or trade-off rather than relying on console output.

Do not claim suite success until you have evidence from the authoritative results artifact: enumerate every test result, confirm none failed or regressed, and disclose any trade-off despite a successful command summary.
